example-acme.title: Agents we sketched after our chat
example-acme.note: This is an example of a private page. You'd write a short note here about what you discussed, then list the agents you designed for their team, plus any library agents you recommend.

agents.name: Trial-to-Paid Watch
agents.what: Reviews every free-trial account each morning and tells the sales team which ones look ready for a conversation, with the evidence behind each pick.
how: Each morning the agent reads trial sign-ups, product usage and the company behind each account (to confirm)
it matches personal-email sign-ups to companies and checks fit against your ideal customer profile
it ranks the trials showing buying signs, such as several teammates invited or key features used, and notes what's still unknown
the sales owner reviews the short list before anyone reaches out
agents.data: Trial sign-ups and product usage (to confirm); public company data for matching and fit.
agents.who: Growth or sales leadership owns it; account executives act on the list.
agents.first: Run it on last quarter's trials and compare its top picks with the trials that actually became customers.
agents.measure: Share of top-ranked trials that become paying customers; days from sign-up to first conversation.
agents.ask: What does a trial account do in its first week when it is going to buy?
